test_cast_tensor_type: test cast_tensor_type to convert PyTorch tensors between float32 and int32 dtypes
test_auto_fp16_decorator: test the auto_fp16 decorator to automatically cast nn.Module forward inputs to FP16
test_auto_fp16_apply_to: test auto_fp16 with apply_to to selectively cast only specified forward arguments to FP16
test_force_fp32_decorator: test the force_fp32 decorator to cast FP16 inputs back to FP32 in nn.Module forward
test_force_fp32_out_fp16: test force_fp32 with out_fp16=True to cast inputs to FP32 but return outputs as FP16
